headline: Recommends a 10-year time limit for the 76 Congress Street arts center zoning change and approves the 43 St. Lawrence Street building plan.
summary: Members approved a site plan for a seven-unit building at 43 St. Lawrence Street. They recommended a zoning change for 76 Congress Street with a 10-year time limit. They also tabled 41 Ashmont Street at the applicant's request.
decisions: Approved the site plan for 43 St. Lawrence Street, a four-story building with seven units and seven parking spaces, with conditions.
Approved the planning board's decision letter for 43 St. Lawrence Street, and authorized the chair to sign it.
Recommended that the city council adopt the 76 Congress Street conditional zone amendment, with a 10-year time limit.
Tabled the 41 Ashmont Street item to a future date at the applicant's request.
discussion: 43 St. Lawrence parking and buffers: Members asked about traffic on Gilbert Lane, the historic cobblestones, the side setback, and the vegetation buffer at the rear parking area.
76 Congress Street time limit: Members discussed whether the agreement should have an expiration date, and most supported adding a set time limit while noting the project's long history.
76 Congress Street neighbor concerns: A neighbor raised worries about parking and crowds from a 400-seat venue, while another speaker supported the project.

Comprehensive Plan 2040 update: Staff described the update as a refresh of the 2030 plan, with about two years of public engagement, and members asked how past outreach worked and whether a board liaison would be named.
